knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A foreign and older figure is labelled historical and is not used as an Australian fact.
Competitor entries record observations with the date seen. Guessed figures and unverified claims are not recorded as facts.
For shared pools the decision usually sits with the body corporate or strata manager, and the segment is defined by that role.

practicalCriteria: Each customer segment names the decision-maker and frequency
Each market figure has a source and date, or is labelled an assumption
Each competitor entry contains only dated observations
Foreign or historical figures are labelled and not used as Australian facts
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed segment worksheet and source list
stopWorkCriteria: Market claim presented as fact with no source
Competitor prices or staff numbers invented
